thesis: EXEL is a high-quality, cash-generative biotech in a strong uptrend (close 70.58 above SMA20 66.78, SMA50 61.59 and SMA200 51.84, ret_63 +40%) in healthcare, the leading sector of a risk-off tape. The reward/risk only clears 1.5 at the zone midpoint 69.65 (1.66), while at the last close 70.58 and premarket 70.5 it is about 1.27-1.30. Heavy-volume reversals at 73.69 (11/5) and 72.14 (11/10), a price above the mean analyst target 61.57, 14.4% short interest and no news check leave the edge too thin to open a position today.
invalidation: A daily close below 64.5 (under the 10-day swing low 64.75) breaks the pullback structure; the Hold would become Overweight only after a hold in the lower zone (68.7-69.65) with a clean news check.
key_risks: News feed unavailable: offering, M&A, litigation or regulatory headlines cannot be ruled out, and the cause of the 10/30 post-earnings gap is not confirmed
Distribution signs near the 52-week high: 11/5 reversal 73.69 to 68.71 on 4.4M shares and 11/10 close 70.58 off a 72.14 high on 5.6M shares (vol_ratio 1.55)
